tools_helpful.evidence: TURN 2-4: bootstrap pre-seeded MIGRATION-MAPPING.md with per-file Triage labels and copied the UWP source; the agent worked straight off the mapping.
Bootstrap 'Next' steps instruct resolving each TODO via Get-MigrationPattern.ps1 -Anchor <id>; anchored fetch keeps the model away from the whole PATTERNS.md.

tools_problematic.problem: Any file containing an 'unsupported' inventory hit is auto-collapsed to Triage=defer, even when the only blocker is a hero UI control (InkCanvas) that has a documented XAML-placeholder path. This dropped the whole Scenario1 page.
tools_problematic.evidence: session-log.txt L303: 'Scenario1_InkCanvasTactileFeedback.xaml.cs | defer | copied'; .bootstrap-meta.json deferredCount:1; MIGRATION-DEFERRED.md tagged it 'unsupported-only'.

tool_limitations.limitation: The unsupported scan (script section 1, 'any hit collapses the file to defer') cannot distinguish a whole-file-killing API (CoreWindow, phone-only, kiosk) from a single unsupported visual control on an otherwise-migratable scenario page.
tool_limitations.suggested_tweak: Partition unsupported hits: hero UI controls with a placeholder path keep the file as migrate-with-adaptation (placeholder TODO) instead of defer, so the scenario stays in navigation.

doc_errors.where: SKILL.md navigation invariant #4 (L109) vs SKILL.md L229-236 + MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md L57-65
doc_errors.wrong: Invariant #4 says 'Deferred items are omitted from the navigation surface', which the agent applied to a whole scenario page whose only blocker was an unsupported hero control.
doc_errors.correct: A scenario page whose only blocker is an unsupported hero control must stay registered in navigation with a visible placeholder; only omit a scenario that has no representable UI at all.

special_apis.special_handling: Not in the stable WinAppSDK channel (InkCanvas is experimental-only, InkToolbar unavailable per the official What-is-supported page). Correct handling is to replace the control with a visible declarative placeholder and KEEP the scenario page in navigation — not to drop the scenario.

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: Only 4 of the 5 UWP scenarios registered in the WinUI nav; Scenario1 (Ink Canvas Tactile Feedback) absent, nav-to-title lands on Scenario2.
dev_agent_struggles.turns_or_retries: single-pass — followed the pre-seeded defer label without reconsidering
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: Initialize-UwpMigration.ps1 auto-labeled the InkCanvas page 'defer' (unsupported-only); SKILL.md invariant #4 told the agent deferred items are omitted from navigation, so it removed the whole scenario.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: Not resolved — shipped with the scenario missing (score 80/100, feature FAIL).
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Tooling: do not collapse a hero-UI-control-only file to defer — keep it as migrate-with-adaptation with a placeholder TODO so the scenario stays in nav. Prose: fix invariant #4 to keep such scenarios with a placeholder.
